node.title: Re^3: Filehandle in subroutine in use VRML.pm
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
... despite my various solutions and workarounds from my nodes [id://11145313|here] and [id://11145345|here] being much better than the following, if you're hell-bent on only modifying sub printout, here's enough rope to shoot yourself in the foot: (Update: Note the following only works because of the absence of [doc://strict]...)

sub printout { my ($lines, $_fh) = @_; my $fh = $_fh ? caller.'::'.$_fh : *STDOUT; foreach my $line (@{$lines}) { print $fh "$line\n"; } } # End printout;

Though you may need to replace [doc://caller] with the string "main" if printout gets called from another package. /shudder
